subject: Gades
text: In the Fortress of Doom, Gades will attack, use Destroy, or use Undead to raise his attack power.

evidence.quote:
He will do 1 
of 3 things during his turn; attack, use Destroy (a stronger version of his 
attack) or use Undead, which raises his attack power.

subject: Gades
text: Counter Gades's Undead spell by casting Courage with the hero.

evidence.quote:
Every time he uses 
Undead, counter by casting Courage with the hero, and starting the fight by 
casting Courage might be a good idea although I didn't find it necessary.

subject: Gades
text: Against Gades, Jerin should heal with Champion or Valor, cast Trick on Aguro and the hero, or use Rally if a character falls.

evidence.quote:
Keep your characters at full strength with Jerin's Champion or Valor spells. 
Otherwise she should cast Trick on Aguro and the hero or Rally if a 
character happens to fall in battle.

subject: Amon
text: Amon casts Sunder and Chaos, but both spells can be blocked by Jerin's Mirror spell.

evidence.quote:
Amon uses powerful spells such as Sunder, so keep Jerin casting those 
Mirror spells. Amon knows Chaos, which confuses your characters, but this is 
also blocked by Mirror.

subject: Chaos
text: If a character becomes confused during the battle with Amon, use a shriek on that character.

evidence.quote:
If one of your 
characters becomes confused, use a shriek on that character.

subject: Fortress of Doom
text: After beating Amon, players can leave the Fortress of Doom to save their game, but leaving is not possible after defeating Daos.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, after beating 
Amon it's possible to walk away and leave the Fortress of Doom to save your 
game, but not after beating Daos.

subject: Daos
text: Jerin's Mirror spell reflects Daos's spells such as Flood, Glacier, Thunder, Dread, and Amnesia.

evidence.quote:
As with Amon, use Mirror to reflect his spells such as Flood, Glacier, 
and Thunder, and also those really annoying spells like Dread and Amnesia

subject: Daos
text: Daos casts Stronger when he is running low on HP to recover health.

evidence.quote:
He'll use Stronger if he's running low on HP, which is almost like a free 
turn for your characters since you should be doing much more damage per 
round than what he recovers.

subject: Daos
text: Ensure the party has high HP and MP before finishing off Daos because there is no opportunity to heal before fighting the last boss.

evidence.quote:
Try to make sure 
your party has high HP and MP before finishing him off because there's no 
opportunity to heal before the battle with the last boss.

subject: Guard Daos
text: On each turn, Guard Daos will either cast Flood or cast Figual.

evidence.quote:
Each turn he gets he'll do one of only two different things; cast 
Flood or cast Figual.

subject: Guard Daos
text: Guard Daos's Figual attack targets the whole party with confusion, but both Flood and Figual can be blocked by Mirror.

evidence.quote:
Figual hits each member in your group and will 
either miss or confuse the character (very annoying). Both of these attacks 
can be blocked by Mirror, meaning the Mirror spell will be extremely 
important in this battle.

subject: Elven Bow
text: Equipping Jerin with her original Elven Bow before fighting Daos allows her to safely attack confused party members to cure them with minimal damage.

evidence.quote:
Also, a trick that might come in handy is to attack your party with Jerin's 
bow if a lot of them are confused and their HP isn't low, in order to 
restore everyone at once. For this reason, equip Jerin with her original 
Elven Bow before battling the sinistral Daos since it will do less damage to 
your characters and you should never use Jerin to attack anyway (get it back 
at the Isle of Forfeit if you've sold it).

subject: Lufia
text: Lufia joins the party for the battle against Guard Daos, but the player cannot change her equipment beforehand.

evidence.quote:
Lufia joins you for this battle, 
but you will not get to mess around with her equipment before the fight.

subject: Guard Daos
text: If Lufia is wearing the Flash Ring, her Thunder spell can deal up to 500 points of damage to Guard Daos.

evidence.quote:
Hopefully she is still wearing the Flash Ring from back in the Glasdar 
Tower, because if so her Thunder spell will make this battle a great deal 
easier. Usually, Lufia should be casting Thunder (up to 500 points of 
damage!), Aguro should be attacking, Jerin should be casting Mirror, and 
your red headed character should be attacking (or healing if needed).

subject: Guard Daos
text: Guard Daos is defeated after taking around 6600 points of damage, beating the game.

evidence.quote:
After you deal around 
6600 points of damage you'll win the fight and beat the game.
